children: Bhatt joins after more than 13 years at Zydus Group, bringing over two decades of experience across HR, talent and business partnering

BDR Pharmaceuticals has appointed Niral Bhatt as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), strengthening its people leadership team as the pharmaceutical company continues to build its workforce and organisational capabilities.

Bhatt brings more than 20 years of experience across human resources, talent management, leadership development and business partnering. He joins BDR Pharmaceuticals after more than 13 years with Zydus Group, where he most recently served as General Manager, Human Resources.

During his tenure at Zydus, Bhatt held several HR roles, including Deputy General Manager and Senior Manager, with responsibilities spanning capability building, compensation benchmarking, talent management, performance management, employee engagement and succession planning.

Earlier in his career, Bhatt worked with Aditya Birla Group, Larsen & Toubro, Café Coffee Day and Future Group India, as well as the Academy of Human Excellence and Mahendra Exports. He began his HR career in the early 2000s and has worked across different aspects of the employee lifecycle and people management.

Bhatt holds a postgraduate degree in Human Resources from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda. At BDR Pharmaceuticals, he will lead the company’s HR function, bringing experience across talent, employee engagement, leadership development and people strategy.
